rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses sponsored or approved by Board-recognized organizations; CPR from AHA, American Red Cross, ASHI, National Safety Council, EMS Safety Services or other Board-approved agencies
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE applies within the first biennium; a new hygienist may instead show CODA-accredited dental hygiene coursework from the previous two years.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; hours must be earned in the biennium they are applied to.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; send documentation within 30 days of the audit letter. Keep records 3 years after the biennium ends.

topics.who: Infection control incl. dental unit water lines (since 2024)
Current CPR; in-person CPR/BLS/ACLS earns 4 h

rules.notes: At least 15 h scientific/clinical and at least 11 h in person. Max 12 h per day. Current CPR required (Rule 150-5-.04); in-person CPR/BLS/ACLS earns 4 h. Hygienists giving local anesthesia: 2 h local anesthesia CE per biennium (counts toward 22).
rules.rule_quote: (1) Dental hygienists licensed to practice in the state of Georgia shall maintain and furnish to the Board, upon request, official documentation of having completed a minimum of twenty-two (22) hours of continuing education during each biennium.
